title: Telecom NOC & Field Network Dispatch Configuration

org_configured.description: True once Telecom NOC & Field Network Dispatch organization thresholds and connectors are configured.

organization_name.description: Tenant legal entity or department name.

p1_subscriber_threshold.description: Subscriber impact count escalating correlated root incident to P1 Critical.

p2_subscriber_threshold.description: Subscriber impact count escalating correlated root incident to P2 Major.

enforce_safety_cert_expiry.description: Block technician dispatch when climbing/high-voltage cert is expired as of dispatch date.

require_all_spares_reserved.description: Require 100% spare kit availability before marking work order READY_FOR_DISPATCH.

provisioning_sla_days.description: B2B circuit provisioning SLA target in days.

high_value_mrc_usd.description: B2B MRC threshold escalating aged fallout to executive triage.
